positive_prompt:
COUNT LOCK — HIGHEST PRIORITY: reproduce EXACTLY the same number of people as appear in the provided photo. Not one more, not one fewer. If the photo shows one person, the output must show that one person completely alone. If it shows three, exactly those three. Never invent, add, duplicate, or imagine any additional person. The bus deck behind and beside them is completely empty. No other passengers, no bystanders, no pedestrians, no faces in the distance.

IDENTITY LOCK: use the faces, identities and appearance of the subject or subjects in the provided photo. Keep each one exactly as they appear — same pose, same position, same gesture, same left-to-right order. Each keeps their own exact facial features, face shape, skin tone, hairstyle and hair colour, ethnicity, body size and build, outfit, and every accessory (glasses, sunglasses, watch, headscarf, jewellery, bag). Do not blend, swap, average or beautify any face. Do not add, remove or alter clothing or accessories. Only restyle them into the new scene. Each looks toward the camera with a natural, confident, closed-mouth smile.

SCENE: the subject or subjects stand at the railing of the open-top upper deck of a double-decker city sightseeing bus, hands resting on the top rail, parked at the Bundaran HI roundabout in Jakarta. Red and white deck seating and a steel grab pole are visible at the lower edges of the frame, all empty and unoccupied. Behind them: the Selamat Datang Monument — twin concrete pylons supporting a high horizontal slab topped by two small bronze figures — positioned in the left or right third of the frame, never directly behind anyone's head, and fully visible from base to top. The wide fountain pool sits below it, with the Jalan Thamrin skyline of modern glass towers receding behind.

FRAMING: photographed by a photographer standing in front of the subjects at natural standing eye level, straight-on, horizon level. Not a selfie, no arm reaching toward the lens, no wide-angle distortion. Waist-up to mid-thigh crop. Every face sharp and individually recognisable.

LIGHTING: warm late-afternoon sunlight coming from behind and slightly to the side of the camera, so faces, railing and monument are all evenly and warmly front-lit. Clear deep blue sky filling the upper frame, deepening to rich azure at the top and warming to soft gold near the horizon, with a few crisp white clouds. Bright, clean, high-visibility air. Soft shadows falling away from the viewer. No lens flare, no sun in frame, no silhouettes, no haze.

CAMERA: ARRI Alexa 35, Zeiss Supreme Prime 35mm, f/5.6, subjects sharp and the monument clearly readable behind. Realistic skin texture with natural pores and subtle imperfections, no plastic smoothing. Photorealistic, cinematic colour grading, editorial commercial quality, high resolution.
